g.title: Work record storage (MOD-011)
Implementation sources
Coherent inspection, BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction, candidate validation and current revision.
Stable project association, qualified SQLite connection and schema initialization.
Normalized typed SQL row loading and saving.
Complete record/reference and current support validation.
Explicit task construction and issue disposition.
Named retained payloads and safe referenced cleanup.
Fenced backup, restore, migration and exact staged recovery.
Selected snapshot/payload inventory and integrity.
Ordinary operation leases and exclusive maintenance exclusion.
Qualified readonly v3 source capture and explicit disposition.
Contained durable filesystem primitives.
Qualified v3 source reads and narrow source-lock coordination; no legacy record writer.
Normalized schema version 1; migration ownership stays with the executable.
Shared closed record validation and storage outcome primitives consumed by the persistence implementation; public admission remains MOD-010-owned.
